name: @aethelred/wallet-reputation
description: ERC-8004 agent identity bridge + deterministic reputation aggregator + VC-gated receiver policy. Given a payment request from an autonomous agent, this package resolves the agent's on-chain identity, aggregates reputation signals (VCs, payment history, TEE attestation health, revocations) into a single score, and evaluates receiver-declared acceptance rules against the result. MoltPe's receivers have to trust MoltPe; ours trust a pluggable issuer set that regulated merchants can pin themselves.
